batting.name: PA Patel
batting.dismissal: c VY Mahesh b V Sehwag

batting.name: S Vidyut
batting.dismissal: c VY Mahesh b GD McGrath

batting.name: MS Dhoni
batting.dismissal: c Shoaib Malik b Mohammad Asif

batting.name: JA Morkel
batting.dismissal: c V Sehwag b R Bhatia

batting.name: V Sehwag
batting.dismissal: c M Muralitharan b Joginder Sharma

balls.text: great way to end the innings! Bhatia errs by serving up a full toss which Badri heaves away over midwicket for six, and thats a good strike
got em with a full toss! Morkel sees the freebie and looks to hit it into oblivion but makes a meal of it, instead top-edging to Sehwag, lurking at short third man
steps down and converts it into a full toss, but doesn't time it well, lofting down to de Villiers at long-on on the bounce, tidy over from Bhatia
shuffles in his crease and Bhatia keeps it full again, and Morkel drives wide of him down the ground where Malik does well to get around in a hurry
gets across and tries the paddle but short fine leg is well positioned
good ball, full just outside off and its steered past Sehwag at backward point
good comeback, a yorker just outside off stump which he squirts to gully
awesome! Morkel you beauty! Thats two in two as Morkel tees off again, this time also over long-on but not so squarer, but who cares?
good strike, but is it too late? Morkel connects well to the slower delivery, clearing  the front leg and sending the ball miles back over long-on to raise the 150
well bowled again, right up there in the blockhole and Badri can only poke it to the man at backward point, this may well prove to be decisive from Delhi

well done, boss, right up there in the blockhole and Morkel mistimes the slog to cover, Raina calls for the risky single and Sangwan swoops in to collect and flick the ball onto the stumps to catch him short
full on the stumps, an agricultural heave goes nowhere but to midwicket
change of pace, fullish on leg stump, worked with a flourish to midwicket
full again, Raina uses his feet but drives straight to extra cover

fraction short, Raina pulls past square leg and the ball drops safely and deviates away from Dhawan on the ropes, who adjusts excellently to dive out and save it, then fires in the flat throw that Karthik just collects a second to late, else the batsman was a goner
overpitched but Morkel can only drag across the line to midwicket
short and wide and thats a thumping cut past cover and point, wuff!

and he gets Dhoni, who gets down and hammers a low full toss down to long-off, where Malik dives forward and takes an excellent catch low to the grass, that ball was hit very flat but the fielder judged it to perfection
overpitched outside off stump and he reaches out to smack to long-on
short again, change of pace, Morkel makes room and cuts square for one out to Malik running around at deep backward point
a much-needed boundary at last, as Morkel swivels and connects very well on the short ball, pulling into the ground past the gap at square leg
touch too short, he gets back and hits that towards extra cover
too, too wide outside off stump as Sangwan loses grip on the ball
short on the hips, again cramped but Morkel tucks it to short fine leg
short of a length on the stumps, gets cramped and cuts to Sehwag at cover
oh thats a superb over in the end of a Twenty20 match, this one's a slower ball, an attempted yorker outside off stump but Morkel, trying to squeeze it to third man, cannot make contact
another dot! Yo Mahesh bowls back of a length and beats Morkel as he stands in his crease and tries to cut this time
top over this, as Yo Mahesh invites the drive by pushing it fuller, but Morkel gets too much bottom hand into the shot as he drags it to Asif a midwicket
good stuff again, just back of a length and Morkel, trying to inch forward, taps it to backward point and cannot set off for the single
tidy again, hitting a length and Dhoni tucks it past square leg for one
well bowled, offering no room and Dhoni can just push that to point
and he connects with with the slap over backward point, safely into the gap and third man is too far too run around and cut it off, Morkel off the mark in style

and he gets Vidyut, slipping in a short one thats targeted at the body, cramping a tired Vidyut for room as he steps outside his crease and shapes to pull but only manages a slap into cover's hands, a good innings on IPL debut is cut short by a master tactician
right up there in the slot and Dhoni can only drive it to the man at cover
makes room and just manages to get the bottom end of the bat on his slog across the line, the ball rolls towards midwicket and he sprints off for one
a tad short and he clubs it along the turf out to long-off for a single
fullish length outside off and Dhoni misses out an expansive off-drive
short again, he makes a total mess of the attempted pull, top-edging over short fine leg and it again drops safely into no man's land for McGrath to field
makes room, closes his eyes and swings across the line, but Yo Mahesh hits a good length and beats the bat
drops in a short one outside off stump and Dhoni, getting elevated, slaps it in the air down to McGrath running around at third man to field it
step down again but cannot drive this one away and Yo Mahesh fields
slips out a full toss outside off stump but Dhoni loses a hand off the bat as he tries to swipe it away, the ball goes into the gap past midwicket for two
full down the pads as he sees Dhoni coming down the track, he misses out on the flick and the ball dribbles back to the bowler
bouncer over middle and leg, Vidyut goes hooking but gets beaten
full on off stump but he patiently drives it down to long-off for one
on a good length but he comes onto the front foot, driving down the track
more room, this time he cuts in front of square, out to Gambhir in the deep
oh shot, boss! Dhoni gets a bit of room and transfers the weight perfectly, cutting down into the ground past backward point and it speeds away for four

slower ball on the stumps, he waits for it and then opens the face to nudge it to backward point, looks at Dhoni who calls for the quick single and thats his fifty in his first match, well played, Vidyut
steps out and drives a rank full toss between cover and point for two
better shot, more controlled, walking down and slashing past a diving de Villiers at point out to the deep cover sweeper
just over mid-off's head, as Vidyut steps out and goes aerial with the fuller ball, its over Bhatia and lands safely, then rolls away for a four to beat the fielder
steps out to leg, exposing three sticks, and tries the same shot but gets beaten second ball in a row, not sure what he's thinking, as his orthodox shots are good
slower ball on a length and just skims past the bat as Vidyut opens the face and attempts to cheekily run it wide of the wicketkeeper
comes out, drives the ball to cover, who dives to his right and saves runs
full and flat on leg stump and Vidyut drives straight to the fielder
fired in full and flat on middle and leg and thats clipped out to the deep
massive! Dhoni skips down and heaves with the spin, connecting extremely well for a dinger over deep midwicket, a spanking shot for six
again he comes out, the ball is very full and he pushes it to extra cover
makes room and drives into the covers this time, good running
top shot, making room and driving very straight over the bowler, good stuff
another top-edge! Asif drops short, Dhoni takes his eyes off it as he pulls, and the ball flies over a leaping Karthik for four more ... Asif having no luck so far in Chennai
exposes the stumps and drives well to cover, where a dives saves runs
on the pads and Dhoni turns it down past square leg for one
slower ball loops out and ends up a gentle beamer outside off stump, which Vidyut waits for and then pokes down to third man, no ball not called, oddly
banged in short and Vidyut gets a top-edge over the 'keeper, he wanted to pull that past midwicket but the ball gained on him and got him into a tangle
too short and Dhoni skips down, pulling past square leg to the sweeper
too wide and he gets the toe end of the bat on it as he reaches out and slashes, the thick edge runs wide of short third man to the boundary
thats poked into the gap at cover and point and Dhoni gets off the mark
quicker one slides into the pads and he fails to flick it away
comes out first ball, Sehwag sees him and fires it in, and the Chennai captain turns the ball straight to midwicket
and he strikes first ball, as Parthiv slashes a short one up in the air straight to the  the fielder at short third man, who didn't have to do a thing, just pouch the catch
comes forward, waits as the ball spins away, and cuts hard to point
looks to come down but Malik fires it in and he clips it to midwicket
gets some width and drives into the gap between cover and point
another arm ball, this time outside off stump, raps the front pad
another wide one down leg stump beats bat and wicketkeeper
flat down leg stump, he misses, ball clips pad and a wide is called, the run too
backs away, looking for room, and delicately dabs it to short third man where there's a fumble
back of a length, swings in and he runs it down to third man for one
short of a length outside off, asking to be slapped but he misses out
rubbish bowling, a full toss outside off stump and thats slapped off the front foot over extra cover and McGrath cannot get around in time
looking for the yorker he pitches full on leg stump and thats tucked to the man at midwicket, not timed well so he cannot place it into the gap
quick, quick bouncer which he tries to hook but cannot connect, that one takes off and is called a wide for height
full and wide, Vidyut backs away and loses his balance as he tries to slash it way and thats a dot ball
short and wide, cut way uppishly through the gap down to third man
banged in short, he goes hooking and the ball drops safely in no man's land, McGrath jogs in and fields the ball on the deep midwicket boundary
full and wide again and he misses with a booming slash this time
more room outside off stump and Parthiv flashes hard, with a thick outside-edge miles over slip for a one-bounce four that third man cannot get to
full outside off and he goes for an expansive hit but cannot connect
good shot! Parthiv steps aside and hits this over cover for four more
slower ball, wide too, but he drags it into the ground in front of point
more work for Bhatia as this one's turned off the pads to deep midwicket
slashes a wide one over a leaping slip and third man cant get there in time
bouncer on the stumps, he goes hooking but misses, and the umpire says thats one for the over
on the pads again and clipped out to Bhatia, this time along the grass

dropped but a top effort down at deep square leg, as Parthiv chips a ball off the stumps up in the air and Bhatia, sprinting forward and diving, fails to gets his fingertips to it, would have been a YouTube moment had he got it
again some room and Parthiv opens the face, really reaching out, and steers it down to the fielder at third man for a single
oh ho ho, thats pretty wide outside off stump but Bowden lets him go
overpitched again and he square-drives in the air down to third man
better stuff, on an off-stump length with a hint of movement and Vidyut is late on the stroke, just getting bat on it to play it back to Yo Mahesh
top shot to open your account, boss! Gets some width and just laces that off the front foot past backward point for an elegant boundary

but what a response from the young pace bowler! Off stump is sent cartwheeling as the pitches on a good length and defeats Fleming with the movement, he swings across the line very hard and misses the ball completely ... what a start to the over!
bad bowling, very full and wide and Flemo slashes this one over backward point for four more to make it ten runs off one legal delivery!
another overstep and Flemo cracks the short ball just over the hands of a leaping point fielder ... a four and another free hit ... its all happening!

and he strikes first ball, but its a no ball! Good grief, Fleming doesn't move his feet and drags the ball back onto his stumps but Yo Mahesh has overstepped so we have a free hit ... Flemo was walking off but gets called back
full outside leg stump and he mistimes his flick to midwicket

where's he going? Parthiv dances down, shuts his eyes, and tries to hit this one out of the park but doesn't connect at all and the keeper collects ... McGrath gives him a look as if to say hello, kidhar?
makes some room and plays with the movement, jamming the angled bat down in time and running the ball past gully and down to third man
plants his foot forward and steers the ball to backward point, who's sharp
banged in short, he makes a mess of his pull, getting it off the toe end of the bat, the ball pops up in the air ever so slowly but drops agonizingly short of a tumbling Malik at midwicket
back of a length on off stump and he inches forward before playing it back to the left side of McGrath, who runs forward and collects
again on the pads and Parthiv tucks it out to deep backward square leg again, where McGrath easily stops is this time
full outside off stump and he drives expansively to extra cover
outside leg stump and thats a top flick past square leg, where McGrath jogs towards the ball but puts in no effort to stop the ball, looks rather odd
overpitched on middle and off and he swings that past square leg, there's protection out in the deep so Flemo will just get a single
hint of movement squares him up and he gets a leading-edge to gully
full outside off stump and he's beaten going for a lazy offdrive
thats a wide outside off stump, very wide
tight stuff on off stump and Parthiv defends it to cover
marginally short and he mistimes his attempted pull over midwicket, the ball holds up near the ropes and Yo Mahesh collects and fires in a good return
pitches outside leg and clips Flemo's pad as he tries to whip it away, McGrath lets out a half-appeal but stops as the ball dribbles to square leg
same channel just outside off, shaping away, and Flemo leaves it be
and he leaves it go as McGrath hits his straps outside off stump and gets the ball to shape away, he has had a great IPL so far
off the mark immediately, tucking one from out in front of his pads to short fine leg to send the partisan Chennai fans into a tizzy
there it is, courtesy a pull over square leg to a juicy full toss, and Delhi have won by eight wickets to tie Chennai and Rajasthan on the points table!
yorker-length ball on leg stump, clipped in the air over midwicket
too short and thats pulled efficiently over midwicket, landing safely, Gony comes in and returns a throw that Dhoni collects, but a sliding Dhawan makes it
excellent shot, a straight-driven shot so, so hard and firm that it speeds past the umpire and bisects two men running across on the ropes, awesome
change of pace, on a length and now he drives a single to extra-cover

better stuff, reverse-swinging yorker down leg stump and de Villiers flicks down to deep backward square leg, harrying back excellently as Dhoni takes a good throw but he's so darn fast that he makes it comfortably
but thats sloppy, very sloppy, Morkel slipping a wide well down leg stump
well bowled, a top over seriously, given the situation, Gony slipping in the split-fingered yorker outside off stump to beat Dhawan
beaten on the drive, Dhawan reaching outside off stump but the change of pace and shape away from Gony undoes him, a hint of reverse?
full again, he makes room and square-drives into the gap for one
in the slot to be driven but he can't beat Raina at short cover, good shot
full on middle and off, he flicks across the line but can't beat midwicket
too straight and Dhawan has time to tuck off the pads to midwicket
too short, he gets right on top of it and hammers it through the covers
a touch short and he drags it across the line towards midwicket
oh ho ho! Dhawan gives himself room to cut but doesn't pick the ball at all and it rears back into him, cramping him all ends up
full on middle and off, well driven back, and Murali fields very well
flatter one outside leg stump, he steps back and misses out on the shot
flighted outside the pads, Dhawan paddles in the air over short fine leg and runs very quick, aided by a speedy de Villiers, and gets back for two, well run
fuller length and he plays an eye-catching straight drive back to Ntini
bit of room as Ntini angles it across and he cuts down to third man
short one, he allows it come onto him and nudges into the gap at gully
too straight and de Villiers twirls the ball down to Morkel at deep backward square leg, calling for two immediately and he sprints the first one superbly
angled across him at a good pace, he's late on the dab and edges in front of slip, who fumbles and allows a scampered single to Dhawan
hits a good length and Dhawan pushes to Badri at cover, who's sharp
short of a length outside off stump and de Villiers gets across and runs it down to third man, where Sharma dives to save runs
back of a length outside off and he cuts out to Ntini at cover sweeper
is greeted by a short one and tries to uppercut but gets beaten
bowled em! Gambhir inside-edges trying a cheeky dab to third man, just succeeding in dragging the ball back onto the stumps, and a good innings is over
much better length, on off stump, and de Villiers drives to extra cover
slides down the pads and he just rolls the wrists to ease that away behind square for another boundary, its so easy for Delhi
back of a length on middle and leg, he defends it to midwicket

sees some width and steers it down to third man, where a fumble from Morkel allows a second and that Gambhir's second fifty on the trot, from 35 deliveries, and the IPL's leading run-scorer raises his bat to an appreciative crowd, well played, Gauti
comes forward and square-drives a good-length ball past point
well bowled, rolling the fingers across, but its easily tapped to point
big, very big! Gauti sizes up Sharma, clears the leg, and has a good old fashioned slog rows back over deep mid-on, lovely strike from him
shuffles across to get Sharma dropping wide, then he neatly opens the face and runs the ball down to third man for an easy single
makes room to cut, just bringing bat down on time, but point fields it
comes a few feet down, converting it full, and on-drives the ball for one
spins into him as he gets across, and he's nearly beaten on the shot
gives it some air but its the wrong line and de Villiers clips past midwicket, running hard, and he's complimented by Gambhir's athleticism
skips down, Murali keeps it flat but Gauti flicks it out to the deep
quicker one outside off, he gets across and defends it to point
kneels down and square-drives a full toss into the gap behind square
change of pace but he gets across to nudge it to midwicket for one
another pleasing shot, this time straighter, gets him off the mark
comes onto the front foot and drives a good-looking shot to cover
and an entertaining knock comes to an end, Sehwag uppercutting a short one up over backward point and gully straight into Murali's lap down on the ropes
mistimed slog goes over mid-on and drops safely in no man's land
swings at one down leg and gets an inside-edge onto the thigh
top shot, lust leaning into a full one and lacing backward of point and there's so much speed on it that the ball evades two fielders
tucks a short one off the hips down to deep fine leg for a single
goes pulling a nasty bouncer down leg stump, misses, and Morkel is warned
shuffles around, ball slips past leg stump, Dhoni collects and sees Gambhir outside his crease and throws the ball down but misses, and they steal a run
steps to leg and attempts to upper-cut the bouncer over third man but fails to make room, Morkel appeals but Sehwag did not make contact
quicker one squares him up but he ends up running it to point for one
shuffles around, waits for turn and tucks it off the pads for a single
beaten by the topspinner, under-cutting past Dhoni and leg stump
shuffles around, misses the ball, takes it on the pad outside the line of leg stump, Sehwag harries off for the leg-bye and has to turn and get back, had the throw been accurate he was in trouble
spins into him, he gets back and steers to point and sets off, a good flat throw comes in from Badri but thats some excellent running from Gambhir
well bowled, full in the zone and he inside-edges, making room to leg
low full toss outside off stump and he carves it away backward of point
there's the 100 as Gambhir steers a short one upward of gully, which is appreciated with plenty of cheer from a superb Chennai crowd
attempted yorker slides down leg stump, he misses the flick, Morkel appeals but that cannot be given out
well bowled, slipping down into him as he makes room, then sneaks between pad and bat to beat him, Dhoni collects, maybe a thin inside-edge
change of pace and length, he waits and turns it off the pads for one
couple steps down and he clubs that, golf-like, straight for four, class
flatter on the stumps, he gets forward and plays the ball to midwicket
cheeky, Sehwag coming onto the front foot and waiting for turn, then opening the face and gliding the doosra wide of Dhoni for four, excellent
steps out to leg stump and drives inside-out to extra cover
skips down and heaves it along the ground to Ntini at deep midwicket
releasing the ball, he touches the side line with his back foot so the umpire calls no-ball, and Sehwag tucks it from the pads to midwicket
doosra lands outside off stump and spins away past the bat
flat outside leg stump, he shuffles and clips the ball to midwicket
he is on a roll, Sehwag, just cutting with firm hands into the gap at point
poor ball, down the pads and he turns it away past short fine leg to raise a speedy half-century, excellent innings from the entertainer
crunches another short one but cant beat Badri at backward point

comes down, gets under a full one and slashes it up, up into the air and it settles down in deep backward point's hands but being a free hit Sehwag cant be out, very well taken by Badri, keeping his eyes under that massive skier
smashed! Sehwag latches onto the short ball and pulls very, very flat over midwicket and the ball just crosses the rope ... its a no-ball to boot, so we have a free hit
low full toss which he drives easily down to long-off for a single
makes a bit of room and steers a shortish one down to third man
full length, Gambhir checked his shot to extra cover
streaky shot that, gets the edge and it flies for a boundary through the vacant slip region
came down the track, but misses it
tries to repeat the stroke, but can't pierce the field this time
Gambhir is extremely strong square on the off, some width provided and he dismisses it for four
on a length, on off , Gambhir jabs it square on the off, and takes a quick two and with that he becomes the tournament's leading run-getter
Gambhir works it square on the leg, a direct hit from the fielder but the batsman was in and they take a run from the richochet
backs away and slaps it square for another boundary, Gambhir is getting into the act as well
superb shot, full length this time and punched down the ground by Gambhir for four
pitches outside leg, comes in and raps his pads, no runs
short and angling in towards on, Sehwag plays it away square for a single
dabbed to mid-off and a quick single results
full toss on his pads, Sehwag gives it the treatment it deserves and it races away to the square-leg boundary
gives himself room and slashes it to third man
short on middle and leg, Gambhir tries to pull it away, but doesn't get hold of it and no run results
low full toss on off stump, Sehwag plays it down to mid-on
Sehwag is a man in a hurry, picks that from outside off and deposits it at the midwicket boundary
short and follows Sehwag who was making room for himself, he whips it to the right of mid-on where Murali does the fielding
short and outside off, Gambhir attempts a cut, but is beaten
can't make contact as the ball thuds into his pads
good line from Ntini, half opened the face, races away through vacant second slip for a four
back of a length, gets behind the line and pushes it to point
short  and speared down leg, but Sehwag has backed away so much it passes between him and the stumps
Gambhir tucks it away for a single to midwicket
on a length, driven by Gambhir for a single to Joginder at mid-off
on a length, a little bit of width, Sehwag dabs it down to third man
short, down the leg, looks to work off the ribs but misses, its a wide
short of length, on the stumps, tucked away to square leg
shot! Sehwag makes room and slaps a short one up over point for another flat six, insane
short, on stumps, steps away to leg and swings and misses
Sehwag welcomes Gony with a huge six, makes room and slogs it over long-off
back of a length, nips in, he adjusts and runs it down to third man
change of pace, hitting a length and Sehwag pats it back down the track
at that pace thats flying away over third man for a flat six, as Sehwag smashes the wide one very hard, the tall man Gony down on the ropes looks on as it sails over
and now he's down the track, making room, flaying away to a fuller one but missing by miles, very ungainly from Sehwag
ripper to start off, a real peach, hitting back of a length and seaming away a good pace to beat a leaden-footed Sehwag, who fishes off the back foot
good start, a length ball on middle and off and Gambhir, defending, gets an inside-edge past leg stump to short fine leg
